public_run_preregistration.seed_extension_policy: The public seed set is fixed at 400–409 and will not be extended after results are seen.
public_run_preregistration.tied_cluster_policy: Any future ranking of a tied top-model cluster will be a separate pre-registered study on the private evaluator seeds.

request_size_guard.failure_mode: Refuse the request before the provider call when the conservative prompt upper bound reaches the threshold.

sampling_policy.effort: medium where exposed; recorded per transcript
sampling_policy.thinking: adaptive for Anthropic Opus 5; provider-specific reasoning tokens recorded where returned
sampling_policy.prompt_cache: Anthropic ephemeral system-block cache with 1h TTL

power_analysis.design: paired two-sided contrast on certification-seed policy ladder
power_analysis.interpretation: Ten seeds clears the 80% planning target for the smallest observed ladder contrast; this is power for paired policy contrasts, not a guarantee of model-ranking power.

public_transcript_analysis_command: python3 -m bench_bench build-leaderboard --input-dir runs/v0.2-public-leaderboard --json reports/PUBLIC_LEADERBOARD.json --markdown reports/PUBLIC_LEADERBOARD.md
public_transcript_note: The v0.2 public run contains 40 complete live transcripts for models claude-opus-5, gpt-5.6-sol, muse-spark-1.2, and grok-4.6 on seeds 400–409 at 52 weeks. The analyzer excludes transcripts with provider transport failures or hard-constraint violations from counted aggregates while retaining raw scores and audit metrics. The four-model seed-400 paid smoke remains separate.
smoke_retention_command: python3 scripts/build_archive.py --source-dir runs/v0.2-smoke-20260815 --archive artifacts/v0.2-smoke-20260815-transcripts.tar.gz --manifest artifacts/v0.2-smoke-20260815-manifest.json --expected-file-count 4 --label 'v0.2 four-model seed-400 paid smoke after cache and prompt clarification' --archive-prefix v0.2-smoke-20260815-transcripts --archive-path-label artifacts/v0.2-smoke-20260815-transcripts.tar.gz
retention_command: python3 scripts/build_archive.py --source-dir runs/v0.2-public-leaderboard --archive artifacts/v0.2-public-transcripts.tar.gz --manifest artifacts/v0.2-public-manifest.json --expected-file-count 40 --label 'v0.2 public live run' --archive-prefix v0.2-public-transcripts --archive-path-label artifacts/v0.2-public-transcripts.tar.gz
public_leaderboard_note: The authoritative leaderboard is generated by public_transcript_analysis_command from the 40 v0.2 public transcripts. The four-model seed-400 paid smoke is not part of the leaderboard and is retained at the separate smoke artifact paths. The benchmark card remains pending incorporation of the completed results.

claude-fable-5-1.canary_policy: Seed 400 is the first official extension episode and also the canary. Count it only after the predeclared structural, provenance, rejection, transport, cost, and credential-scan checks pass; otherwise stop, fix, and rerun from seed 400 under the new hash.
claude-fable-5-1.leaderboard_command: python3 -m bench_bench build-leaderboard --input-dir runs/v0.2-fable-5-1-public --json reports/FABLE_5_1_LEADERBOARD.json --markdown reports/FABLE_5_1_LEADERBOARD.md
claude-fable-5-1.retention_command: python3 scripts/build_archive.py --source-dir runs/v0.2-fable-5-1-public --archive artifacts/v0.2-fable-5-1-transcripts.tar.gz --manifest artifacts/v0.2-fable-5-1-manifest.json --expected-file-count 10 --label 'v0.2 Fable 5.1 model extension' --archive-prefix v0.2-fable-5-1-transcripts --archive-path-label artifacts/v0.2-fable-5-1-transcripts.tar.gz
